_comment: Hand corrections on top of overlay.generated.json. The import script never overwrites this file. See README 'Correcting the map'. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

lifts._why: Confirmed by Emily 2 Nov 2026 · 8 Nov 2026: shown on the stairs chip (owner: try merging stairs and lifts).

items._example_delete: set an item id to null to remove it, e.g. "stairs-1-3": null

room-spontaneous-conversation-area._why: Green box drawn in Canva; flood-fill cannot see it. Rect copied from the PDF. In the Extra category since 8 Nov 2026 (owner); green = its printed box.

lifts-2._why: Label only present as hidden text on the 2nd-floor page; consistent with the main lift on other floors.

food-0._why: Meal times from Emily, 3 Nov 2026: Fri dinner only Cafeteria + 3rd floor

food-1.name: Catering · Cafeteria
food-1._why: The nearest printed room name is Einstein's, but the catering box is in the cafeteria (8 Nov 2026).

room-registration-info-desk-wardrobe._why: Label sits on the long narrow room (tan counter strip + grey room) along the hall; traced from the plan. Moved +51.6/+1.6 pt with the 8 Nov PDF (ground-floor plan picture re-cropped).

room-main-entrance._why: The entrance vestibule (double doors in the outer wall) right next to the label; traced from the plan. Moved +51.6/+1.6 pt with the 8 Nov PDF (ground-floor plan picture re-cropped).

room-nap-rooms._why_shapes: Owner, 10 Nov 2026: the room between the toilets and the right-hand nap room is a nap room too (4th shape, hand-traced). The import followed only 3 of the label's 4 lines; the first 3 shapes are its outlines.

room-humboldt-hall._why: Traced by the import since 5 Nov 2026 (divider Humboldt/Cafeteria in scripts/import-config.json); was hand-traced. Outline = the hall inside its inner walls, incl. stage.

room-kleist-hall._why: Seat rows broke the flood-fill. Inner faces of the hall's walls (incl. stage), measured on the plan.

room-arnheim-foyer._why: Traced by the import since 5 Nov 2026 (rooms up to 8 % of the page allowed); was hand-traced. Long hall from the top doors to the Nap Rooms wing; stairs, toilets, registration room and entrance vestibule are outside it.

room-edison._why: Traced by the import since 5 Nov 2026 (divider along its door wall in scripts/import-config.json); was hand-traced.

room-third-floor-foyer._why: Foyer and Voltaire are one open area on the plan, split along the row of pillars / folding partition (y 599.5): a divider in scripts/import-config.json. Traced by the import since 5 Nov 2026; was hand-traced.

room-voltaire._why: Split from the foyer by the divider at y 599.5 (scripts/import-config.json). Traced by the import since 5 Nov 2026, incl. stage; was hand-traced.

stairs-0-2._why: Owner, 10 Nov 2026: same staircase as stairs-2-2 and stairs-3-2; goes to the 2nd and 3rd floor, not the 1st.

stairs-1-3.description: Between the cafeteria and the 1st-floor foyer
stairs-1-3._why: Owner, 10 Nov 2026: a few steps between two parts of the 1st floor, no other floor.

stairs-2-2._why: Owner, 10 Nov 2026: same staircase as stairs-0-2; ground, 2nd and 3rd floor, not the 1st.

stairs-3-2._why: Owner, 10 Nov 2026: same staircase as stairs-0-2; ground, 2nd and 3rd floor, not the 1st.

stairs-1-4._why: Same staircase as stairs-0-3 (ground floor, 'To floor 1'); its own note reads as floor 1.

stairs-2._why: 2nd-floor labels are hidden text; same spot as stairs-3 (to 1, 2) and stairs-1-2 (to 2, 3).

gwwc-booth-1.name: Effektiv Spenden & GWWC Booths
gwwc-booth-1._why: Orange printed box; donation diamond (owner, 8 Nov 2026).

project-fair-1.name: Project Fair
project-fair-1._why: Dark-blue printed pin; Project fair's old icon (8 Nov 2026).

_decisions: 2 Nov 2026: areas painted over with grey boxes in Canva are closed off - correctly left out.
2 Nov 2026: hidden old text on the 2nd floor (incl. 'Point 3 - Conversation Area') is stale - correctly ignored.
2 Nov 2026: English UI only. Coat check / registration / first aid / quiet rooms: searchable as rooms is enough, no extra categories.

3 Nov 2026: Share button works on Emily's phone. Meal times added to catering (Fri dinner 18:00-19:00 Cafeteria + 3rd floor only; Sat/Sun lunch 12:30-14:30 all three). Museum exhibition gets its own category chip (waiting for the Canva PDF).

8 Nov 2026: new Canva PDF (museum, catering boxes). Chip order: meeting points, toilets, food, stairs & lifts (one chip), fairs & booths (Org fair + Project fair + Effektiv Spenden/GWWC in one category), charging, AIS Museum. Category colours match the printed boxes (catering red, fairs pink, museum blue, charging orange).

8 Nov 2026 (later): Charging, AIS Museum and the Spontaneous Conversation Area (2nd floor, was only a room) merged into one 'Extra' chip, listed like Fairs & booths. Item ids unchanged; old ?cat=charging / museum / inspecting links open Extra.
8 Nov 2026 (later): fair boxes always shown, like catering and museum (owner). Org fair hours 'Saturday, 14:30–16:30' under its label on the map (item mapNote) and on its card.

8 Nov 2026 (later): new 'Rest & care' chip (link napping): Nap Rooms, Prayer and Meditation Room, Parents' Room, Childcare (Austen Kids Room). Silent Working Room joins Extras after Charging. Item ids unchanged.
